en.titre: 5 niche habits of disgustingly well-read people

en.texte: the second a word, a name or a place confuses you, look it up. two minutes, not later. curiosity is exactly when your brain remembers best
after you learn something, explain it out loud in simple words. the parts you can't explain are the parts you didn't really get
you don't need to read all of plato. learn the 20 ideas everyone references: the allegory of the cave, occam's razor, the prisoner's dilemma

en.titre: One lesson a day on Sophia
en.texte: 10 minutes, a lesson written by an actual professor, then a quiz so it sticks. history, philosophy, science, economics. a tiny lecture every morning
link every new fact to one you already know. history explains economics, economics explains politics. knowledge compounds when it's connected
